# Morgan Stanley to Start Trading Under 'MS' Ticker Symbol

 Jan 11, 2006 

 Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MWD) announced today that its common stock will begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol 'MS' effective January 17, 2006. 

 John J. Mack, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Morgan Stanley, said, "Our new symbol more closely aligns our ticker with the Morgan Stanley name and better reflects the 'one-firm' approach that we're pursuing. Our global franchise has been operating under the Morgan Stanley name for years, and now we're bringing our ticker symbol in line with that powerful brand name. This new symbol also reflects the actions we're taking to move forward as one firm and work together across businesses to realize the full potential of our global franchise and deliver superior returns to our shareholders." 

 Morgan Stanley common stock has been trading under the symbol 'MWD' since 1997.

corpus.title: Ticker symbol
corpus.snippet: A ticker symbol or stock symbol is an abbreviation used to uniquely identify publicly traded shares of a particular publicly listed company or security on a particular stock exchange. Ticker symbols are arrangements of symbols or characters (generally Latin letters or digits) which provide a shorthand for investors to refer to, purchase, and research securities. Some exchanges include ticker extensions, which encode additional information such as share class, bankruptcy status, or voting rights into the ticker.
